name: TC-170: balance check shows not-found for a nonexistent code
description: Checking the balance of a code that doesn't exist shows 'Card not found or invalid code'.
descriptionHtml: Checking the balance of a code that doesn't exist shows 'Card not found or invalid code'.

testStage.description: Checking the balance of a code that doesn't exist shows 'Card not found or invalid code'.

steps.name: Wait for selector getByRole('heading', { name: 'Choose an amount' })
Wait for selector getByRole('heading', { name: 'Check a balance' }).locator('xpath=ancestor::div[2]').getByLabel('Gift card code')
Fill "NOPE-A9472C25" getByRole('heading', { name: 'Check a balance' }).locator('xpath=ancestor::div[2]').getByLabel('Gift card code')
Press "Enter" getByRole('heading', { name: 'Check a balance' }).locator('xpath=ancestor::div[2]').getByLabel('Gift card code')
Expect "toBeVisible" getByRole('heading', { name: 'Check a balance' }).locator('xpath=ancestor::div[2]').getByText('Card not found or invalid code')
